pages.title: Cast
pages.text: Use three Raw Copper, a reusable fired Casting Mold, one fuel charge, explicit ignition, and Bellows air. The Crucible Furnace produces one Cast Copper Billet after 240 active ticks.

pages.title: Anneal
pages.text: Smelt the Cast Copper Billet in a normal furnace for 140 ticks to produce an Annealed Copper Billet. This transforms the item. A Kiln cannot anneal or smelt it.

pages.title: Forge
pages.text: Heat the annealed billet in a lit Kiln, transfer it to the Stone Anvil, and perform Flatten, Draw, Bend, Flatten while Workable. The result is a Copper Ingot. Cooling retains unfinished actions; reheat to resume.

pages.title: Use Copper
pages.text: One Copper Ingot makes eight Copper Fasteners for the Quern. Copper and strong bindings make a Copper Knife. Primitive copper progression normally removes vanilla copper smelting/blasting bypasses; a server may disable that replacement.
